issues.location: Theorem C p3; Remark1.4 p4; Proposition4.6 p23; Example6.7 p41; Theorem6.8 p42; Remark6.9 p43; MN22 author PDF Theorem1.2 p2
issues.claim: Full gl2 skein-lasagna comparison exceeds fixed integer-class result
issues.evidence: Zero-framed unknot: Kh(U^omega) degree(0,0) dimension2; full S0^2(S2xD2) contains independent A0^m for every integer m, all degree(0,0).
issues.counterevidence: Theorem6.8 chooses integer representatives {0,1}^r; Remark6.9 acknowledges other classes/foams. These do not quotient the full module.
issues.repair: Restrict comparison and consequent invariance claims to proved fixed-class scope, or define/prove precise sl2/mod2 or all-integer gl2 construction.
issues.impact_boundary: Counterexample to literal full-module TheoremC; not to existence of omega_i or elementary handle slide.

acceptance_check.source_claim_and_assumptions: TheoremC p3 explicitly compares total Kirby color with the full gl_N/N=2 skein lasagna module, without fixing integer H2. Theorem6.8 p42 fixes i in{0,1}^r.
acceptance_check.independent_argument: For the zero-framed unknot, total-color degree(0,0) has dimension2. The actual retained MN22 Theorem1.2 p2 gives Z[A1,A0,A0^-1], deg A0=0; all A0^m are independent after scalar extension. Forgetting H2 grading cannot identify those vectors. Primary read the full TheoremC/Remark1.4/Theorem6.8/Remark6.9 wording and MN22 p2, and independently assessed this dimensional contradiction.
acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_core_dependency: The mod2 sl2 remark does not redefine the explicitly cited full gl2 module. The fixed-class theorem is narrower and source Remark6.9 acknowledges integer-class grading differences. This affects a central comparison and its invariance deduction, not existence of the Kirby object or the elementary handle-slide isomorphism.
acceptance_check.repair_scope: Restrict the target to the actual fixed classes or define and prove a precise sl2/mod2 or all-integer comparison; a nomenclature change alone does not suffice.
